create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance for storing rollout data in RL training with observation and action spaces
insert_rollout_data: insert observations, actions, rewards, and hidden states into the rollout storage buffer
compute_returns: compute GAE or Monte Carlo returns from stored rewards and value predictions
generate_mini_batches: generate shuffled mini-batches of rollout data for RL policy gradient training
move_to_device: move all rollout storage tensors to a specified device like GPU or CPU
